U2_spec.status: post-hoc, registered 2026-11-20 after review; NOT scored on 2026-27 at registration
U2_spec.model: Poisson team strength: log lam_home = mu + home + att_h + def_a; log lam_away = mu + att_a + def_h; Dixon-Coles rho -0.06 in the score grid; no calibrator
U2_spec.likelihood_weight: 0.5 ** (age_days / half_life); matches older than 4 half-lives dropped; refit once per ISO week on matches dated before that week's Monday
U2_spec.prior: per club, tau/2 * sum((theta - target)^2) over att and def, tau = 10 (decayed match-weight units), fixed
U2_spec.prior_target: (0, 0) for a club that played in this division in the previous season; otherwise mean att/def of the three clubs with the lowest att - def in a fit made at the end of the previous season
U2_spec.half_life_selection: walk-forward on 2025-26 (weekly refits), 1X2 log loss, from {365, 540, 730} days; never uses 2026-27
U2_spec.gate: same as AUDIT.md section 2.4; first scoring can earn at most collect-more-evidence/shadow; a ship decision needs the season-end look
